versions.subject: updating search syntax, splitting process name and cmdline and adding category
updating falsepositives documentation to remove line that's not applicable
updating selections to make query more efficient and less prone to evasion
versions.detection:
selection1:
  - ProcessName|endswith: '/rm'
selection2:
    CommandLine|contains: '/var/log'
selection3:
    Commandline|contains|all:
        - '/Users/'
        - '/Library/Logs/'
condition: selection1 and (selection2 or selection3)
